camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/deleteAppResourcePermissions --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'items=[{resourceKey=app.demo.resource_1, scope=RESOURCE, resourceType=APP_RESOURCE}]' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Deletes multiple resource permissions within an application
description_zh: 批量删除应用内资源权限
name: DeleteAppResourcePermissions

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the resource belongs. If not specified, the current tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属租户 ID；省略为调用人当前租户
parameters.name: resource_tenant_id

fields.help_en: The list of grantee principal IDs
fields.help_zh: GRANTEE 主体 ID 列表
fields.name: grantee_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the grantee user belongs. This parameter is optional if the user and the resource belong to the same tenant, and is required for cross-tenant users
fields.help_zh: GRANTEE USER 所属租户；同资源租户可省略，跨租户 USER 必填
fields.name: grantee_tenant_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include dot-separated descendant resources for the RESOURCE. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: RESOURCE 是否包含点分后代资源；省略为 false
fields.name: include_descendants

fields.help_en: The dot-separated resource key whose first segment is the application key of the APP
fields.help_zh: 首段为 APP 应用键的点分资源键
fields.name: resource_key

fields.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to APP_RESOURCE
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: The deletion scope: by resource or by principal
fields.help_zh: 删除范围：按资源或按主体
fields.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The scope of the permissions to be revoked
parameters.name: items

code.description_en: The business status code. The value 200 indicates success

deletedCount.description_en: The number of deleted permission records

message.description_en: The error message. This field is empty if the request is successful
